name: Toronto
feasibility: spatial/services first; revenue/value blocked by missing open assessment roll
summary: Toronto has strong open data for boundaries, roads, bike, transit, parking, zoning, permits, fire, and population, but no Edmonton-equivalent open parcel/account assessment roll with assessed value, class, and coordinates/neighbourhood.
privacy: Official assessment roll access is public-inspection/in-person and includes owner/tenant information; do not scrape or republish. If obtained lawfully, strip personal fields and aggregate early.
